description: Fetch full context for a single PTPGE term: definition, broader/narrower relations, exactMatch / closeMatch mappings, properties, notation, level, and metadata. Accepts either a full URI (https://ptpge.org/v1/...) or a relative path under /v1/.

id_or_path.description: Full URI or relative path under /v1/. E.g. 'printing/configurations/formats/a-series/a4'.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for which label and definition variants to return flat.

name: ptpge_get_term
title: Read a term
